violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) in the walk-in cooler, Raw shelled eggs were observed being stored over buckets of onions and prepared sauces 2) in the 2DR prep top cooler, cook line side, Raw intestines were observed being stored over prepared sauces
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED THE WALK IN COOLER SO THAT THE RAW SHELLED EGGS WERE NOT STORED OVER READY-TO-EAT FOODS. PIC MOVED THE RAW INTESTINES TO THE BOTTOM SHELF AND THE SAUCES TO THE TOP SHELF IN THE 2DR PREP TOP COOLER. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed staff cut frozen Raw beef with the meat slicer. Staff wiped down the meat slicer with a dry rag and proceeded to preform another task.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO CLEAN AND SANITIZE THE MEAT SLICER AFTER CUTTING RAW BEEF. STAFF BEGAN SANITIZING THE MEAT SLICER. KING CANON / KOGIYA (Inspection Date: 09/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR counter top Hot Box: prepared rice was observed at 100f. Upon discussion with PIC, rice was prepared 1 hour prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC STATES THE RICE IS DISCARDED EVERY 4 HOURS. PIC WILL DISCARD THE RICE IN 3 HOURS. MOVING FORWARD, RICE WILL BE PLACED ON TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL AND WILL BE LABELED WITH THE TIME IT WAS SET OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED (4 HOURS LATER).

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRINK FROM AN OPEN CUP IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS HAD EMPLOYEE LESVE THE KITCHEN WITH THE OPEN CUP AND EDUCATED EMPLOYEES THAT ALL DRINKS MUST HAVE A LID.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED RICE TO 165F.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: kimchi in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.EMPLOYEE ADDED DATES.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: disclosure statement was missing from the menu for Korean bbq and hotpot
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poisonous or Toxic Material
violations.observation: Observed a soap bucket being used to store food.
violations.corrective_action: Do not store food in containers previously used to store poisonous or toxic materials. This practice may result in food contamination and subsequent medical consequences to anyone consuming the contaminated food. PIC DISCARDED FOOD AND BUCKET.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3): shrimp, octopus and squid
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: kimchi 45-47F, shredded cabbage 47-48F, fish cakes 46-47F, potato salad 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.OBSERVED UNLABELED CHEMICAL SPRAY BOTTLE BY THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC PURCHASED A FOOD THERMOMETER ON AMAZON.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 dr prep top (front), 2 dr prep top (back ), 2 dr under counter
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC PURCHASED THERMOMETERS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed knife stored between equipment
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC TOOK THE KNIFE TO BE CLEANED.
